summary: Full token efficiency audit of the Antigravity system. Measures 46.8MB across 5,687 files, identifies genius.md files (avg 31KB, max 149KB) as the biggest controllable expense, and provides 5 actionable recommendations: genius.md size cap at 50KB, conversation discipline, session boundaries, and behavioral optimization. Concludes the system architecture is already well-optimized — the main risk is behavioral (multi-expert loading) not structural.
